notes.title: Update: Private Lobbies, Performance Boost & Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
We've just rolled out a new update with some highly requested features and improvements:

🔹 Private Lobbies – Create your own lobby and race only with friends!
🚀 Performance Improvements – Smoother gameplay and better stability
🐞 Bug Fixes – We’ve tackled various issues to make your experience even better

Jump in, test out the changes, and let us know what you think! Your feedback helps us keep improving the game.

notes.title: Update: Improved Controls, Gamecontroller Support & Faster Tracks!
notes.content:
🚀 New Movement System – Smoother and more responsive controls
🎮 Full game controller Support – Play the way you prefer
🏁 Simplified Tracks – Faster, more dynamic, and even more fun to race on!

🔜 Coming Soon (Today-Tomorrow):
🔹 Private Lobbies – Play only with your friends!
🔹 Map Selection in Private Parties – Choose where you want to race!

Try it out and let us know what you think. Your feedback helps us make the game better!
